subject: Interactive add-in using browserViewer() must be manually terminated

messages.author: 8beb8a310872ab1a
messages.subject: Interactive add-in using browserViewer() must be manually terminated
parts:
Hello.

I'm writing an interactive RStudio add-in by following the official directions at: http://rstudio.github.io/rstudioaddins/

That page documents the paneViewer(), dialogViewer(), and browserViewer() functions, and my app is appropriate for the browserViewer() option, so that's what I'm using.  The official documentation on it seems to be here: http://shiny.rstudio.com/reference/shiny/latest/viewer.html

What I'm missing is this:  When the user closes the browser tab containing the launched app, the console in RStudio is still running the server part of the app, and one must stop it with the red stop-sign button on the top right of the console pane.  I would like the server to terminate automatically when the user closes the browser tab, just as it would if I used dialogViewer() and the user closed the dialog, so that the user has their console back as soon as they return to RStudio.

Is there a way to accomplish this?

Thanks in advance,

Nathan Carter
